name: Warp Defenses
body:
School transmutation; Level bloodrager 2, magus 2, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/2 levels (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You reach out and impact the defenses of the target. The target takes a penalty to their AC and regeneration equal to -2, with an additional -1 penalty for every six levels you have (maximum -5 penalty at 18th level). This spell cannot reduce their AC below 10 + their Dexterity or reduce their regeneration below 0.
